ex.en: The minister denied any personal involvement in the decision to cut the research budget.
ex.zh: 部长否认自己个人参与了削减科研预算的决定。

senses: adj. 向内的,在内的,里面的

ex.en: The city has turned its attention inward, focusing on rebuilding neglected neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 这座城市已将注意力转向内部，专注于重建长期被忽视的街区。

senses: 表行为、状态、行为的结果，名词词性

ex.en: The suffix '-ion', as in 'action' and 'education', marks nouns denoting acts or their results.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ion（如 action 和 education 中）标示表示行为或行为结果的名词。

senses: 表示“属于……的”，形容词词性

ex.en: The ending '-ior', as in 'superior' and 'inferior', forms adjectives of comparison.
ex.zh: 词尾 -ior（如 superior 和 inferior 中）构成表示比较的形容词。

ex.en: The suffix '-ious', as in 'various' and 'obvious', typically forms adjectives.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ious（如 various 和 obvious 中）通常构成形容词。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Negotiations over Iran's nuclear programme resumed after months of stalemate.
ex.zh: 经过数月的僵局，有关伊朗核计划的谈判得以恢复。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Archaeologists warn that conflict has endangered ancient sites across Iraq.
ex.zh: 考古学家警告说，冲突已使伊拉克各地的古迹处于危险之中。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ireland.usage: adj. Irish；人 Irishman, Irishwoman; the Irish

ex.en: Ireland's economy grew rapidly after it attracted large numbers of technology firms.
ex.zh: 爱尔兰在吸引大量科技企业入驻后，经济迅速增长。

phrases.p: an iron fist in a velvet glove

ex.en: Before the railway age, iron was carried long distances by canal boats at great expense.
ex.zh: 在铁路时代之前，铁靠运河船只长途运输，费用高昂。

senses: adj. 挖苦的,具有讽刺意味的;出乎意料的

ex.en: It's ironic that he got married—he used to say "marriage is the tomb of love".
ex.zh: 真讽刺，他竟然结婚了——他过去常说“婚姻是爱情的坟墓”。

ex.en: It is ironic that the fire station itself burned down last winter.
ex.zh: 讽刺的是，消防站去年冬天自己被烧毁了。

ex.en: She gave an ironic smile when asked whether she trusted the promise.
ex.zh: 当被问及是否相信这一承诺时，她露出讥讽的微笑。

ironically.usage: adv.具有讽刺意味的是；讽刺 地；索引p411

ex.en: Ironically, the safety campaign began the very week of the worst accident in years.
ex.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，安全宣传活动恰好在多年来最严重事故发生的那一周启动。

ex.en: The bridge, ironically, was named after the engineer who doubted its design.
ex.zh: 讽刺的是，这座桥竟以曾怀疑其设计的工程师的名字命名。

ex.en: Ironically, the cheapest products often cost consumers more over time.
ex.zh: 讽刺的是，最便宜的产品长期来看往往让消费者花费更多。

senses: n. [C,U] 具有讽刺意味的事
n. 有讽刺意味的事,嘲弄
irony.usage: 族ironic a.讽刺的；反语的；ironically ad.具有讽刺意味地；n.具有讽刺意味的情况；反语， 讽刺；iron意为“铁”；irony“话语冰冷如铁、生硬如铁”→讽刺

ex.en: The irony of the historian's craft is that its practitioners always know that their efforts are but contributions to an unending process.
ex.zh: 历史研究这个行当的讽刺意味在于，从事研究的人一直知道，他们的努力只不过是为永无止境的过程添砖加瓦而已。

ex.en: The irony is that the safety device itself caused the accident.
ex.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，安全装置本身造成了这起事故。

ex.en: She noted the irony of a free-speech campaigner trying to silence her critics.
ex.zh: 她指出了一个讽刺之处：一位言论自由活动人士竟试图让批评者闭嘴。

ex.en: History is full of the irony of inventions meant to save time that consume it instead.
ex.zh: 历史充满讽刺：许多本为节省时间的发明反而占用了时间。

senses: a. 无理性的；失去理智的
adj. 不合理的，失去理性的
irrational.usage: ir-（不）+ration（理性）+-al（形容词后缀）→不理性的→荒谬的。反rational a.理性的；索引p411

ex.en: Consumers are sometimes irrational.
ex.zh: 消费者有时是不理性的。

ex.en: Fear of flying is often irrational, given the safety record of airlines.
ex.zh: 考虑到航空公司的安全记录，对飞行的恐惧常常是不理性的。

ex.en: Markets can behave in irrational ways when investors panic.
ex.zh: 投资者恐慌时，市场可能会表现出非理性的行为。

senses: adj. 不规则的,无规律的;不稳定的
adj. 无规律的；不合常规的
irregular.usage: adj.不整齐的；无规律的；不正 常的 n.非正规军军人；索引p411

ex.en: The irregular heartbeat forced the athlete to withdraw from the competition.
ex.zh: 心律不齐迫使这名运动员退出了比赛。

ex.en: Employees complained about the irregular working hours that made family life almost impossible.
ex.zh: 员工们抱怨不规律的作息时间使家庭生活几乎无法维持。

ex.en: Fossil records suggest the species grew in an irregular pattern depending on food supply.
ex.zh: 化石记录表明，该物种依据食物供应状况以不规则的模式生长。

senses: a. 不相关的；不相干的
adj. 无关紧要的；不相关的
irrelevant.usage: adj.不相关的，不相干的；索引p411

ex.en: The judge ruled that the previous convictions were irrelevant to the current case.
ex.zh: 法官裁定，先前的定罪与本案无关。

ex.en: Critics argue that data collected years ago is now irrelevant to modern consumers.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，多年前收集的数据如今已与现代消费者不相关。

ex.en: His personal habits are irrelevant to whether he can perform the job well.
ex.zh: 他的个人习惯与他能否做好这份工作无关。

senses: adj. 情绪高涨的,劲头十足的;十分强烈的
adj. 无法控制的;难以遏制的
adj. 抑制不住的；充满精力的

ex.en: Even after the disappointing result, the team showed irrepressible enthusiasm for the next season.
ex.zh: 即使结果令人失望，这支队伍对下一个赛季仍表现出抑制不住的热情。

ex.en: The scholarship is awarded to all qualified applicants, irrespective of their family background.
ex.zh: 奖学金授予所有符合条件的申请者，而不考虑其家庭背景。

senses: v. 冲洗(伤口等),滋润,使清新
irrigate.usage: ir-（进入）+rig（水）+-ate（动词后缀）→把水引入田地→灌溉。族irrigation n.灌溉；水利；派生 irrigable adj. 可灌溉的；irrigation n. 灌溉；他反复灌溉irrigate已湿润的土地，让大家很生气irritate

ex.en: The waters in these three rivers irrigate the plains of Punjab.
ex.zh: 这三条河流的水灌溉着旁遮普的平原。

ex.en: Farmers in the region irrigate their fields with water drawn from deep wells.
ex.zh: 该地区的农民用深井中抽取的水灌溉田地。

ex.en: New channels were built to irrigate the dry farmland on the hillside.
ex.zh: 人们修建了新的水渠来灌溉山坡上的旱地。

ex.en: Modern irrigation systems have doubled crop yields in areas that once suffered from drought.
ex.zh: 现代灌溉系统使曾经干旱地区的作物产量翻了一番。

ex.en: Sleep deprivation commonly produces irritability and poor concentration.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足通常会使人易怒、注意力不集中。

irritable.usage: i(我)+rri(阿姨谐音)+table(桌子)→阿姨生气掀桌子→暴躁的

ex.en: She waved him away with an irritable gesture.
ex.zh: 她气恼地挥手赶走了他。

senses: vt. 激怒,使恼怒,使烦躁
vt. 使激怒；使疼痛；使烦恼
irritate.usage: 辨析：irritate 与 annoy 都表示使恼怒,前者程度、语气更强；派生 irritated adj. 被激怒的,irritation n. 恼怒,刺激物；索引p411

ex.en: Constant delays on this line irritate passengers who commute to the city every morning.
ex.zh: 这条线路不断的延误让每天早上通勤进城的乘客十分恼火。

ex.en: British English often prefers the verb ending '-ise', as in 'realise' and 'organise'.
ex.zh: 英式英语中动词词尾常拼作 -ise，如 realise（意识到）和 organise（组织）。

ex.en: The suffix '-ish', as in 'childish' and 'foolish', often carries a mildly critical tone.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ish（如 childish 和 foolish 中）常带有轻微的贬抑语气。

ex.en: The small island depends almost entirely on tourism for its income and employment.
ex.zh: 这个小岛的收入和就业几乎完全依赖旅游业。

senses: v. 使成为岛屿,使隔离,住在岛屿上

ex.en: The remote isle receives supplies by boat only once a week in winter.
ex.zh: 这座偏远的小岛在冬季每周仅靠船只补给一次。

ex.en: The ending '-ism', as in 'criticism' and 'tourism', forms nouns of practice or condition.
ex.zh: 词尾 -ism（如 criticism 和 tourism 中）构成表示行为或状态的名词。

senses: vt. (使)隔离，脱离；孤立；使(某物质、细胞等)分离
isolate.usage: i(我)+so(太)+late(晚)→聚会我来太晚了，大家都有伴了，我被剩下了→被"孤立"→孤立，(使)隔离；索引p411

ex.en: Patients with the disease should be isolated.
ex.zh: 这种病的患者应予以隔离。

ex.en: There is pressure for change from within the profession, but opponents of change among the regulators insist that keeping outsiders out of a law firm isolates lawyers from the pressure to make money rather than serve clients ethically.
ex.zh: 尽管在行业的内部存在改革的压力，但是管理者中反对改革的人却坚持说，不让业外人士涉足律师事务所可以避免律师由于压力只顾赚钱，而不是恪守职业道德服务客户。

ex.en: Scientists managed to isolate the virus responsible for the strange illness.
ex.zh: 科学家们成功分离出了导致这种怪病的病毒。

senses: adj. 孤独的；单独的；偏远的；绝缘的

ex.en: Some elderly people in isolated rural areas can wait days for a visiting doctor.
ex.zh: 偏远农村的一些老人可能要等上好几天才有医生上门。

isolation.usage: n.隔离，孤立；孤独；绝缘；索引p411

ex.en: Prolonged isolation can damage mental health as deeply as physical illness.
ex.zh: 长期孤立对心理健康的伤害不亚于身体疾病。

ex.en: The patient was kept in isolation until doctors confirmed she was no longer infectious.
ex.zh: 病人被隔离，直到医生确认她不再具有传染性。

ex.en: Rural communities often suffer from isolation because of poor transport links.
ex.zh: 由于交通不便，农村社区常常处于与外界隔绝的状态。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Israel has become a global leader in agricultural irrigation technology.
ex.zh: 以色列已成为全球农业灌溉技术的领先者。

senses: n. [C] 争论的问题；重要议题

phrases.p: issue sth. to sb./issue sb. with sth.

issue.usage: issue to 出版,发行;issue in 导致；索引p411

ex.en: They issued a special set of stamps to mark the occasion.
ex.zh: 他们发行了一套特别的邮票来纪念这个场合。

ex.en: By looking at engineering issues from a marketing point of view, it became clear that the lack of upgrades wasn't due to a quality issue.
ex.zh: 从市场营销的角度看工程问题，很明显，缺乏升级并不是因为质量问题。

ex.en: The committee will issue its final report on air quality at the end of the month.
ex.zh: 委员会将于本月底发布其关于空气质量的最终报告。

ex.en: The magazine's autumn issue includes a long interview with the novelist.
ex.zh: 杂志秋季刊收录了对这位小说家的长篇访谈。

ex.en: The bond issuer must disclose its financial condition to investors.
ex.zh: 债券发行人必须向投资者披露其财务状况。

senses: 表示从事某种职业的人，名词词性

ex.en: The suffix '-ist', as in 'scientist' and 'artist', denotes people engaged in a field.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ist（如 scientist 和 artist 中）表示从事某一领域的人。

senses: 表关于……的，形容词词性；表示性质，形容词词性；动词词性

ex.en: The ending '-istic', as in 'artistic' and 'realistic', forms adjectives describing quality or style.
ex.zh: 词尾 -istic（如 artistic 和 realistic 中）构成描述性质或风格的形容词。

senses: pron. （指提到过的或正在谈论的动物或事物）它

ex.en: Although the experiment failed, it provided valuable data for later researchers to build on.
ex.zh: 尽管实验失败了，但它为后来的研究者提供了宝贵的数据基础。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Italy's small family firms account for a striking share of the country's exports.
ex.zh: 意大利的小型家族企业在该国出口中占有惊人份额。

senses: 表具有……性质的，形容词词性；名词词性

ex.en: The suffix '-ite', as in 'definite' and 'opposite', can mark adjectives or nouns.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ite（如 definite 和 opposite 中）可构成形容词或名词。

senses: n. [C] 项目；一件；（新闻等的）一条
adv. (用于列举项目时)又,同样地
n. 项目；一则，一条；一件商品
item.usage: n.项目，条款；一则，一条；发音类似“爱特目”→我总是喜爱特别的“项目”。；谐音记忆：爱(i)他们(tem)，也爱他们的物品(item)；索引p411

ex.en: Americans, she finds, buy roughly 20 billion garments a year—about 64 items per person—and no matter how much they give away, this excess leads to waste.
ex.zh: 她发现，美国人每年大约购买200亿件服装——每人大约购买64件——不管他们赠送多少衣服出去，这种过度购买都会导致浪费。

ex.en: The last item on the agenda is the plan for next year's conference.
ex.zh: 议程的最后一项是明年会议的计划。

ex.en: Please check each item in your shopping basket before you pay.
ex.zh: 付款前请核对购物篮里的每一件商品。

senses: 表示行为的过程或结果，名词词性

ex.en: The ending '-ition', as in 'position' and 'tradition', marks nouns of state or process.
ex.zh: 词尾 -ition（如 position 和 tradition 中）标示表示状态或过程的名词。

ex.en: The suffix '-itive', as in 'positive' and 'sensitive', typically forms adjectives.
ex.zh: 后缀 -itive（如 positive 和 sensitive 中）通常构成形容词。

senses: det. （指事物、动物或婴儿）它的，他的，她的

ex.en: The company moved its headquarters overseas to reduce operating costs.
ex.zh: 为降低运营成本，该公司将总部迁往海外。

ex.en: The market itself is not to blame; poor regulation caused the crisis.
ex.zh: 市场本身不应受到指责；是糟糕的监管引发了危机。

ex.en: The ending '-itude', as in 'gratitude' and 'attitude', forms abstract nouns.
ex.zh: 词尾 -itude（如 gratitude 和 attitude 中）构成抽象名词。

senses: 表行为的结果，名词词性

ex.en: The ending '-iture', as in 'furniture' and 'expenditure', marks nouns of result.
ex.zh: 词尾 -iture（如 furniture 和 expenditure 中）标示表示行为结果的名词。

ex.en: The suffix '-ity', as in 'ability' and 'equality', turns adjectives into nouns of quality.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ity（如 ability 和 equality 中）把形容词变成表示性质的名词。

senses: 表有……性质的，形容词词性；表物、抽象名词，名词词性

ex.en: The suffix '-ive', as in 'creative' and 'effective', usually forms adjectives.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ive（如 creative 和 effective 中）通常构成形容词。

ex.en: The ending '-ivity', as in 'activity' and 'creativity', denotes capacity or state.
ex.zh: 词尾 -ivity（如 activity 和 creativity 中）表示“……力”或状态。

senses: n. 象牙(或某些动物的长牙)
n. 象牙制品,象牙色,乳白色

ex.en: The international ban on ivory trade has slowed, but not stopped, the killing of elephants.
ex.zh: 象牙贸易的国际禁令减缓了但并未阻止对大象的猎杀。

ex.en: Ivy covers the walls of many historic university buildings in England.
ex.zh: 英格兰许多历史悠久的大学建筑的墙上爬满了常春藤。

senses: 表……化，名词词性；表示行为的过程或结果，名词词性

ex.en: The suffix '-ization', as in 'globalization' and 'urbanization', denotes a process of becoming.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ization（如 globalization 和 urbanization 中）表示“……化”的过程。

ex.en: The suffix '-ize', as in 'modernize' and 'realize', forms verbs meaning to make or become.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ize（如 modernize 和 realize 中）构成表示“使成为……”的动词。

senses: 表示“按……方式处理”，动词词性

ex.en: Verbs ending in '-ize' or '-ise', such as 'organize' and 'organise', differ mainly between American and British spelling.
ex.zh: 以 -ize 或 -ise 结尾的动词（如 organize 与 organise）主要是美式与英式拼法的差别。

ex.en: He took his jacket off because the office heating was far too warm.
ex.zh: 办公室暖气太热，他把夹克脱了下来。

jail.usage: 印刷词头为gaol/jail,gaol为英式拼法

ex.en: He spent three years in jail for revealing state secrets to the press.
ex.zh: 他因向新闻界泄露国家机密而在狱中服刑三年。

senses: vt. 使阻塞,使卡住不动

ex.en: A lorry broke down on the bridge, causing a traffic jam that lasted three hours.
ex.zh: 一辆卡车在桥上抛锚，造成了长达三小时的交通堵塞。

ex.en: In British usage, 'Jan' is the standard written abbreviation for January.
ex.zh: 在英式用法中，Jan 是 January（一月）的标准书面缩写。

ex.en: The new tax policy will take effect in January next year, officials confirmed.
ex.zh: 官员们证实，新税收政策将于明年一月生效。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Japan's aging population has forced companies to rethink traditional hiring practices.
ex.zh: 日本的人口老龄化迫使企业重新审视传统的招聘做法。

ex.en: She kept the kitchen carefully arranged, with every jar of spices labelled by hand.
ex.zh: 她把厨房收拾得井井有条，每一罐香料都亲手贴上了标签。

senses: n. 行话,行业术语,黑话(u)

ex.en: The manual avoids technical jargon so that ordinary users can follow the instructions.
ex.zh: 这本手册避开了专业行话，以便普通用户能看懂说明。

senses: n. (pl.)危险的局面,险境,令人不快的情形

ex.en: The boxer's jaw was broken in the third round and he had to leave the match.
ex.zh: 这名拳击手的下巴在第三回合骨折，不得不退出比赛。

ex.en: The festival attracts jazz musicians from all over the world every summer.
ex.zh: 每年夏天，这个音乐节都吸引来自世界各地的爵士乐手。

senses: a. 忌妒的；吃醋的；珍惜的；精心守护的
jealous.usage: 同义:envious;派生jealousy n.猜忌,妒忌;jealously adv.妒忌地,猜疑地

ex.en: He was jealous of his colleague, who had been promoted twice in three years.
ex.zh: 他嫉妒那位三年内两次获得晋升的同事。

ex.en: She felt jealous when she saw her best friend travelling around the world.
ex.zh: 看到最好的朋友环游世界，她感到羡慕不已。

ex.en: Workers may become jealous if rewards are distributed unfairly.
ex.zh: 如果奖励分配不公，员工可能会心生妒忌。

ex.en: Professional jealousy can quietly poison a workplace, turning colleagues into rivals who refuse to share information.
ex.zh: 职场嫉妒会悄悄毒害工作氛围，使同事变成拒绝分享信息的对手。

ex.en: Dress codes in many technology firms are so relaxed that jeans and trainers are perfectly acceptable.
ex.zh: 许多科技公司的着装规范非常宽松，穿牛仔裤和运动鞋完全可以接受。

ex.en: The Latin root ject, meaning 'to throw', helps learners connect words such as inject, eject and project.
ex.zh: 拉丁词根 ject 意为“投、掷”，帮助学习者把 inject、eject 和 project 等词联系起来。

ex.en: The researchers hired a jeep to carry their equipment along the rough track to the observation site.
ex.zh: 研究人员租了一辆吉普车，载着设备沿崎岖小路前往观测点。

jeopardize.usage: jeopardy（危险）+ize→置于危险中→危及。近义：endanger vt. 危及；jeopard（危险）+-ize（动词后缀）→使处于危险中→危及。近endanger vt.危及；危害

ex.en: Economists warned that raising interest rates too quickly could jeopardize the fragile recovery of the housing market.
ex.zh: 经济学家警告，过快加息可能危及房地产市场脆弱的复苏。

senses: n. 喷气发动机,喷气式飞机(c)

ex.en: Business travelers increasingly choose high-speed rail over jet flights for short distances.
ex.zh: 对于短途出行，商务旅客越来越倾向于选择高铁而非喷气式航班。

ex.en: The stolen jewel, worth several million pounds, was recovered by police in an antique shop.
ex.zh: 那颗价值数百万英镑的被盗宝石在一家古玩店被警方追回。

ex.en: The insurance policy covers personal belongings, including jewellery, only when they are kept in a locked safe.
ex.zh: 该保险只对存放在上锁保险柜中的个人物品（包括珠宝首饰）提供保障。

phrases.m: 王冠上的宝石；最有吸引力(或珍贵、有价值)的东西

ex.en: The museum's collection includes jewelry dating back more than two thousand years.
ex.zh: 博物馆的藏品包括两千多年前的珠宝首饰。

ex.en: Automation is changing the job market, replacing some positions while creating entirely new ones.
ex.zh: 自动化正在改变就业市场，它取代了一些岗位，同时也创造了全新的工作。

senses: n. [C] （英国政府的）就业服务中心

ex.en: After the factory closed, hundreds of redundant workers queued outside the jobcentre searching for new vacancies.
ex.zh: 工厂关闭后，数百名被裁工人排队等候在就业服务中心外寻找新的空缺职位。

ex.en: The jobless rate among young graduates has risen sharply since the financial crisis.
ex.zh: 自金融危机以来，年轻毕业生的失业率急剧上升。

ex.en: Every jobseeker now expects to submit applications through online platforms.
ex.zh: 如今每个求职者都期望通过网络平台提交申请。

ex.en: The workshop teaches jobseekers how to present their skills to employers.
ex.zh: 这个培训班教求职者如何向雇主展示自己的技能。

ex.en: Unemployment benefits are conditional on the jobseeker actively looking for work.
ex.zh: 失业救济金的领取条件是求职者积极寻找工作。

ex.en: Doctors recommend a daily jog of twenty minutes to maintain basic heart health.
ex.zh: 医生建议每天慢跑二十分钟以保持基本的心脏健康。

senses: v. 参加,加入;连接,接合
join.usage: v.参与；成为……的一员；连接； 汇合

ex.en: More than twenty countries have joined the agreement to cut carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 已有二十多个国家加入了这项削减碳排放的协议。

ex.en: She joined the company as a clerk and rose to the position of director.
ex.zh: 她以职员身份加入公司，后来升到了主管的位置。

ex.en: The two islands were joined by a bridge completed in the 1990s.
ex.zh: 这两座岛屿由上世纪九十年代建成的一座大桥连接起来。

senses: n. 接头,接缝,接合处;关节

phrases.m: 联邦和州联合执行移民法

joint.usage: join(连接)+t→想一下两个骨头连接的地方，不就是"关节，接头"吗；索引p411

ex.en: The two sides agreed to establish a joint working group.
ex.zh: 双方同意成立一个联合工作组。

ex.en: The two companies announced a joint project to develop electric vehicles.
ex.zh: 两家公司宣布了一个联合开发电动汽车的项目。

ex.en: As he grew older, pain in his knee joints made climbing stairs difficult.
ex.zh: 随着年龄增长，膝关节的疼痛使他上楼变得困难。

ex.en: The two universities jointly funded a research center for artificial intelligence ethics.
ex.zh: 两所大学共同资助了一所人工智能伦理研究中心。

ex.en: He made a joke about the manager's accent, not realizing how offensive it sounded.
ex.zh: 他开了个关于经理口音的玩笑，却没有意识到这话听起来多么冒犯。

ex.en: She jokingly threatened to sell the piano unless her son practised for at least an hour a day.
ex.zh: 她开玩笑地威胁说，除非儿子每天至少练一小时琴，否则就把钢琴卖掉。

ex.en: The jolly old caretaker greeted every pupil by name as they arrived at school.
ex.zh: 这位快活的老管理员在学生们到校时都能叫出每个人的名字。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Archaeologists in Jordan have uncovered mosaics that shed light on trade routes linking ancient civilisations.
ex.zh: 约旦的考古学家发掘出马赛克镶嵌画，为了解连接古代文明的贸易路线提供了线索。

senses: n. ①(尤指某学科或专业的)定期刊物，杂志，报纸
n. 期刊，日报；日记，日志
journal.usage: 拓展：the journal Nature《自然》杂志。派生：journalist

ex.en: He kept a journal of his travels across Asia.
ex.zh: 他把自己的亚洲之行记录下来了。

ex.en: Her research appeared in a leading journal of environmental science.
ex.zh: 她的研究发表在一份顶尖的环境科学期刊上。

ex.en: He kept a journal in which he recorded the details of each expedition.
ex.zh: 他坚持记日志，详细记录每次考察的情况。

ex.en: Scientists usually submit their findings to peer-reviewed journals.
ex.zh: 科学家通常将研究结果提交给同行评审期刊。

phrases.m: 与法律相关的新闻报道

ex.en: She studied journalism at university before joining a local newspaper.
ex.zh: 她在大学学习新闻学，之后进入一家地方报社工作。

ex.en: Good journalism requires patience, accuracy and a strong sense of responsibility.
ex.zh: 优秀的新闻工作需要耐心、准确性和强烈的责任感。

ex.en: The rise of social media has transformed the economics of journalism.
ex.zh: 社交媒体的兴起改变了新闻业的经济模式。

journalist.usage: n.新闻工作者，新闻记者，记日 志者；journal 的派生词

ex.en: She has been a journalist for 25 years, first at the Sydney Morning Herald and then at the Australian.
ex.zh: 她做了25年的记者，先是在《悉尼先驱晨报》，然后是在《澳大利亚人报》。

ex.en: The journalist spent months verifying the documents before publishing the investigation.
ex.zh: 这名记者在发表调查报道前花了几个月核实文件。

ex.en: Good journalists must distinguish between facts and rumours circulating online.
ex.zh: 优秀的新闻工作者必须区分事实与网上流传的谣言。

ex.en: As a young journalist she covered conflicts across three continents.
ex.zh: 年轻时她以记者身份报道过三大洲的冲突。

senses: adj. 新闻业的,新闻工作(者)的
adj. 新闻工作（者）的；新闻业的
journalistic.usage: adj.新闻工作者的，新闻业的；索引p411

ex.en: The report was praised for its high journalistic standards.
ex.zh: 这篇报道因符合高标准的新闻规范而受到赞誉。

ex.en: He has thirty years of journalistic experience covering politics and economics.
ex.zh: 他拥有三十年报道政治和经济类新闻的经验。

ex.en: Social media is blurring the boundaries of traditional journalistic practice.
ex.zh: 社交媒体正在模糊传统新闻实践的界限。

phrases.m: 途中在某地作短暂停留

journey.usage: 辨析:journey多指陆上直达旅行；voyage指远距离航海/航空；travel泛指旅行、游历；trip指往返旅行；tour指中途多停留的周游；n.旅行，旅程行期，历程，过程 vi.旅行，出游 vt.在…旅行或旅行到过…

ex.en: The train journey from London to Edinburgh takes about four and a half hours.
ex.zh: 从伦敦到爱丁堡的火车旅程大约需要四个半小时。

ex.en: Learning a language is a long journey that demands patience and persistence.
ex.zh: 学习一门语言是一段需要耐心和坚持的漫长旅程。

ex.en: The diary records her journey across the desert in search of ancient ruins.
ex.zh: 这本日记记录了她穿越沙漠寻找古代遗迹的旅程。

senses: n. 高兴；满足；令人高兴的人（或事）；乐趣
n. 欢乐,喜悦,乐事,乐趣

ex.en: To the great joy of local residents, the historic theater reopened after ten years of restoration.
ex.zh: 令当地居民极为欣喜的是，这座历史悠久的剧院经过十年修缮重新开放。

ex.en: Martin Luther King, Jr. delivered his famous speech on the steps of the Lincoln Memorial in 1963.
ex.zh: 小马丁·路德·金于1963年在林肯纪念堂的台阶上发表了那篇著名的演讲。

phrases.p: a judge for the upcoming English speech contest
phrases.m: 接下来的英语演讲比赛的一名评委

ex.en: It takes a while to judge complex aspects of personality, like neuroticism or open-mindedness.
ex.zh: 要判断复杂的性格特征，比如一个人是不是神经质，是不是心胸开阔，则需要一段时间。

ex.en: The judge sentenced the young man to community service instead of prison.
ex.zh: 法官判处这名年轻人做社区服务，而不是坐牢。

ex.en: Don't judge a person by his appearance alone.
ex.zh: 不要仅凭外表评判一个人。

senses: n. 意见，看法，评价；判断力；判决
judgement.usage: 亦作 judgment；记法：judg（判断）+-ment（名词后缀）→判断的能力；索引p411

ex.en: In my judgement, the plan is too costly to be practical.
ex.zh: 依我看，这个计划成本太高，不切实际。

ex.en: The court's judgement was final and could not be appealed.
ex.zh: 法院的判决是终审判决，不得上诉。

ex.en: Doctors must exercise sound judgement when deciding on a course of treatment.
ex.zh: 医生在决定治疗方案时必须运用准确的判断力。

ex.en: Counsellors are trained to listen without sounding judgemental, so that clients feel safe admitting their problems.
ex.zh: 心理咨询师受训做到倾听而不显得妄加评判，让来访者能安心说出自己的问题。

judgment.usage: n.判断，看法；判断力； 判决；真题搭配：journalistic judgment 新闻评论；moral judgment 道德评判；the use of judgement by management 管理层判断力的运用

ex.en: The ethical judgments of the Supreme Court justices have become an important issue recently.
ex.zh: 最高法院法官的伦理判决近来成为一个重要的问题。

senses: n. ①审判(多作不可数)，判决(c/u)

ex.en: In matters of art, personal judgement often carries as much weight as technical training.
ex.zh: 在艺术问题上，个人判断力往往与技术训练同等重要。

senses: adj. ①法庭的，司法的，审判的

ex.en: The judicial system must remain independent to guarantee fair trials for every citizen.
ex.zh: 司法系统必须保持独立，以保障每个公民受到公正审判。

senses: n. （the judiciary）[C] 司法部；司法系统
n. (统称)审判人员;司法部;司法系统

ex.en: Critics warned that the reform would weaken the judiciary and concentrate power in the executive.
ex.zh: 批评者警告说，这项改革将削弱司法系统，使权力集中于行政部门。

ex.en: She filled the jug with cold water and set it on the table beside the glasses.
ex.zh: 她把水壶灌满冷水，放在桌上玻璃杯旁边。

senses: vt. 有效地组织，有效利用（信息、数字、开支等）
vt.&vi. 玩杂耍（连续向空中抛接多个物体）；尽力同时应付（两个或更多的重要工作或活动）
v. 歪曲,篡改;玩杂耍,变戏法;尽量兼顾

ex.en: Many working parents struggle to juggle careers and family responsibilities.
ex.zh: 许多在职父母努力兼顾事业和家庭责任。

ex.en: The accountant was accused of juggling the figures to hide the company's losses.
ex.zh: 这名会计被指控篡改账目以掩盖公司的亏损。

ex.en: The street performer astonished the crowd by juggling five flaming torches.
ex.zh: 街头表演者同时抛接五支燃烧的火把，令观众惊叹。

ex.en: Fresh fruit juice sold in schools must contain no added sugar under the new rules.
ex.zh: 根据新规定，学校销售的新鲜果汁不得添加糖分。

ex.en: The biography promises juicy details about the writer's quarrels with his publishers and rivals.
ex.zh: 这部传记承诺披露这位作家与出版商及对手争执的有趣细节。

ex.en: The final report is due in early Jul, leaving the team barely six weeks to collect the data.
ex.zh: 最终报告须在七月初提交，留给团队收集数据的时间只有六周。

ex.en: July is usually the peak month for domestic tourism in this coastal province.
ex.zh: 七月通常是这个沿海省份国内旅游的高峰月。

ex.en: House prices jumped by nearly ten percent last year, far outpacing average incomes.
ex.zh: 去年房价上涨了近百分之十，远远超过平均收入的增幅。

ex.en: Applications for the autumn intake must reach the admissions office by the end of Jun.
ex.zh: 秋季入学的申请必须在六月底前寄到招生办公室。

senses: n. [C] （公路或铁路的）交叉路口
n. (铁路、公路或河流)交叉点,接合处,汇合处,枢纽站
n. 接合点；交叉路口；汇合处

phrases.p: at the junction of A and B

junction.usage: junct（连接）+-ion（名词后缀）→连接；交叉路口。族juncture n.关键时刻；接合点；在交叉路口（junction）不要上蹿下跳（jump），很危险

ex.en: There's a bridge at the junction of the two rivers.
ex.zh: 两河的汇合处有座桥。

ex.en: Traffic lights have been installed at the busy junction to reduce accidents.
ex.zh: 繁忙的路口安装了红绿灯以减少事故。

ex.en: Turn left at the next junction and you will see the museum on your right.
ex.zh: 在下一个路口左转，博物馆就在你的右边。

ex.en: Students must submit their final dissertations by the end of June to graduate on time.
ex.zh: 学生必须在六月底前提交最终学位论文才能按时毕业。

senses: n. 尔虞我诈的环境;危险地带

ex.en: Much of the Amazon jungle remains unexplored, and new species are discovered there every year.
ex.zh: 亚马逊丛林的大部分地区仍无人探索，那里每年都有新物种被发现。

senses: adj. 等级较低的,资历较浅的
adj. (美国中学或大学)三年级的
junior.usage: 发音类似“嘱你儿”→嘱咐你儿子，因为他还是个“青少年”

ex.en: They want a junior sales manager.
ex.zh: 他们想要一个初级的销售经理。

ex.en: Junior employees should be given opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues.
ex.zh: 应该给资历较浅的员工提供向经验丰富的同事学习的机会。

ex.en: He is junior to me in the firm, although he joined earlier.
ex.zh: 在公司里他的职级比我低，尽管他入职更早。

senses: n. [U] 无用的东西；废旧物品
n. [U] 无用的东西；无价值的东西
n. 垃圾,质量低劣的东西,废品
v. 把(无用的东西)丢弃,废弃
junk.usage: 近rubbish n.垃圾（英）；trash n.垃圾（美）。junk作名词指值钱可能性极低的废旧物

ex.en: Health experts urge schools to replace junk food in canteens with nutritious meals.
ex.zh: 健康专家敦促学校用营养餐取代食堂里的垃圾食品。

ex.en: Campaigners want junk food adverts banned before the evening programmes watched mainly by children.
ex.zh: 活动人士希望在主要以儿童为观众的晚间节目前禁播垃圾食品广告。

senses: n. ①司法权，审判权，管辖权(c/u)

ex.en: With or without permission, they straddle laws, jurisdictions and identities with ease.
ex.zh: 不管有没有得到允许，他们（指移民）都能轻易跨越法律、管辖和身份。

ex.en: Each juror must consider the evidence objectively before reaching an individual verdict.
ex.zh: 每位陪审员在作出个人裁决前都必须客观考虑证据。

senses: n. ①陪审团，全体陪审员
②(竞赛的)评判委员会，裁判委员会
n. 陪审团；（竞赛或展览的）评判委员会
jury.usage: n.陪审团；裁判委员会；jur（公正）+y（名词后缀，表示“人”）→公正的人→在法庭上监督法律使其得到公正执行的人→陪审团。；索引p411

ex.en: After three days of discussion, the jury finally reached a verdict of not guilty.
ex.zh: 经过三天的讨论，陪审团最终作出了无罪的裁决。

ex.en: The jury awarded the young novelist the first prize for her debut work.
ex.zh: 评奖委员会将首奖授予了这位年轻小说家的处女作。

ex.en: The members of the jury were carefully selected from ordinary citizens.
ex.zh: 陪审团成员是从普通公民中精心挑选出来的。

senses: ad. 正好；刚才；现在；只是
adv. 正好,恰好;仅仅,只是;刚才;简直
adj. 公正的,公平的;恰当的;应得的

ex.en: A just society guarantees equal opportunities for all its members.
ex.zh: 公正的社会为其所有成员保障平等的机会。

ex.en: The judge delivered a just verdict that satisfied both parties.
ex.zh: 法官作出了令双方都信服的公正裁决。

ex.en: We have just enough time to catch the last train.
ex.zh: 我们的时间刚好够赶上末班火车。

senses: ②审判，司法(制度)，法律制裁(u)
justice.usage: just(公正)+-ice→公正；反injustice；n.公平、正义；司法、法官；just（正义的）+ice（性质，行为，情况）→正义，公正。拓展：chief justice 首席法官。；联想记忆：just(刚才)+ice(冰)→法官刚才加了一块冰→法官；索引p411

ex.en: It provides opportunities to analyze such ideas as justice, democracy and freedom.
ex.zh: 它提供了分析诸如公平、民主和自由等理念的机会。

ex.en: The new laws are intended to bring the criminals to justice more quickly.
ex.zh: 新法律旨在更快地将罪犯绳之以法。

ex.en: Many people left the court feeling that justice had not been done.
ex.zh: 许多人离开法院时觉得正义没有得到伸张。

justifiable.usage: adj.情有可原的，无可非议的， 有理由的

ex.en: Critics asked whether spending millions on a new stadium was justifiable while local schools lacked basic equipment.
ex.zh: 批评者质问，在当地学校缺乏基本设备的情况下，花数百万建新体育场是否正当。

ex.en: This seems a justification for neglect of those in need, and a rationalization of exploitation, of the superiority of those at the top and the inferiority of those at the bottom.
ex.zh: 这一说法似乎能为忽视那些需要帮助的人找到借口，使剥削合理化，使上层人变得优越，底层人变得卑微。

ex.en: There is no justification for raising prices without improving the service.
ex.zh: 不改善服务却提高价格，这是没有任何正当理由的。

ex.en: The report provides a justification for the extra spending on public transport.
ex.zh: 该报告为增加公共交通支出提供了正当理由。

ex.en: The committee concluded that the extra spending was fully justified by the scale of the emergency.
ex.zh: 委员会断定，鉴于紧急事态的规模，这笔额外开支是完全有正当理由的。

senses: vt. 证明……正确（或正当、有理）
vt. 证明……正当（或有理）；为……辩护
justify.usage: just(公正)+-ify(使)→使公正→证明有理；[族] justification；记法：just（公正）+-ify（动词后缀）→用证据表明某事公正合法；[族] justification n. 正当理由；warrant 的近义词；v.证明…公平、合理；just（正义的）+ify（使……化）→使……正义→证明……是

ex.en: How can the train operators possibly justify yet another increase to rail passenger fares?
ex.zh: 列车运营商如何能够证明再次提高铁路客运票价是合理的？

ex.en: The end does not justify the means.
ex.zh: 目的不能为手段辩护。

ex.en: How can Britain's train operators possibly justify yet another increase to rail passenger fares?
ex.zh: 英国的铁路运营商怎么可能为铁路客运票价的再次上涨辩解？

ex.en: The root juven, meaning 'young', survives in words such as juvenile, rejuvenate and junior.
ex.zh: 词根 juven 意为“年轻”，保留在 juvenile、rejuvenate 和 junior 等词中。

senses: a. 青少年的；未成年的
juvenile.usage: juven（年轻）+-ile（形容词后缀）→年轻的→青少年的。族juvenility n.年轻；不成熟；adj.青少年的，未成年的；幼 稚的 n.青少年；幼鸟

ex.en: The court deals with juvenile offenders in a separate building.
ex.zh: 法院在另一栋建筑里处理青少年罪犯的案件。

ex.en: The bookshop has a special section for juvenile literature.
ex.zh: 这家书店设有少儿读物专区。

ex.en: Critics described the film's humour as juvenile and predictable.
ex.zh: 影评人认为这部电影的幽默幼稚且俗套。

ex.en: The kangaroo covers vast distances across the Australian outback in a series of powerful leaps.
ex.zh: 袋鼠以一连串有力的跳跃跨越澳大利亚内陆的辽阔地带。

senses: adj. 热心的；渴望的；思维敏捷的
keen.usage: 助记:keep(保持)keen(敏锐)眼光;又:keen on热衷于某人/物

ex.en: He is keen for the deal to proceed.
ex.zh: 他渴望交易继续进行。

ex.en: Dogs have a keen sense of smell that helps them detect drugs and explosives.
ex.zh: 狗的嗅觉敏锐，能帮助它们探测毒品和爆炸物。

ex.en: She is keen on photography and spends most weekends taking pictures.
ex.zh: 她热衷于摄影，大部分周末都在拍照。

senses: v. 保留,保存,保持,继续;保守;遵守;守护
keep.usage: retain 的近义词；小记：keep away (from) 远离；keep from sth. 忍住不做某事；keep in mind (that) 记住；keep sb. from (doing) sth. 阻止某人做某事；keep sb./sth. out (of sth.) 使不进入；keep up with

ex.en: If it clears the House, this measure would still have to get through the Senate—where someone is bound to point out that it amounts to the bare, bare minimum necessary to keep the Postal Service afloat, not comprehensive reform.
ex.zh: 此举措如果在众议院得以通过，也仍需获得参议院的批准——而参议院一定会有人指出这充其量也就是保持邮政业务运转的基本条件，而不是全面改革。

ex.en: Regular exercise helps keep the heart healthy and reduces stress.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼有助于保持心脏健康并减轻压力。

ex.en: The museum keeps a valuable collection of ancient coins.
ex.zh: 博物馆保存着一批珍贵的古钱币。

ex.en: Many schools struggle to keep pace with the rapid technological changes reshaping the workplace their pupils will enter.
ex.zh: 许多学校难以跟上快速的技术变革，而这些变革正在重塑学生将来要进入的职场。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Kenya's economy relies heavily on agriculture, with tea and coffee among its leading exports.
ex.zh: 肯尼亚经济严重依赖农业，茶叶和咖啡是其主要出口产品。

ex.en: She put the kettle on and began to tell us about her years abroad.
ex.zh: 她烧上水壶，开始给我们讲她在国外的那些年。

ex.en: Parental support is a key factor in determining how well children adapt to school life.
ex.zh: 父母的支持是决定孩子适应学校生活程度的关键因素。

senses: v. 用键盘输入;将(信息)键入计算机
keyboard.usage: 助记:key(键)+board(板)→可以按键的板→键盘

ex.en: Typing on a keyboard for hours without breaks can cause pain in the wrists.
ex.zh: 连续几个小时不间歇地在键盘上打字可能导致手腕疼痛。

ex.en: Searching the archive with a single keyword brought up more than four hundred related documents.
ex.zh: 用一个关键词检索档案，就调出了四百多份相关文件。

ex.en: The airline allows each passenger one bag of up to twenty-three kg free of charge.
ex.zh: 该航空公司允许每位乘客免费携带一件不超过二十三千克的行李。

ex.en: The new policy gives smokers a strong incentive to kick the habit for good.
ex.zh: 新政策为烟民彻底戒除烟瘾提供了强有力的动力。

ex.en: The program offers free lunches to any kid whose family income falls below the poverty line.
ex.zh: 该项目为任何家庭收入低于贫困线的孩子提供免费午餐。

kidnap.usage: kid（小孩）+nap（n.偷抢）→把小孩偷走→绑架。族kidnapper n.绑匪；kidnapping n.绑架；kid（小孩）+nap（抓走）→抓走小孩，则是绑架→绑架，劫持。派生：kidnapper

ex.en: Two businessmen have been kidnapped by terrorists.
ex.zh: 两名商人遭恐怖分子绑架。

ex.en: Police rescued the child hours after he was kidnapped on his way to school.
ex.zh: 男孩在上学路上遭绑架数小时后被警方解救。

ex.en: The film tells the true story of a girl kidnapped by a gang of smugglers.
ex.zh: 影片讲述了一个女孩被走私团伙绑架的真实故事。

ex.en: The kidnapper demanded a ransom of two million pounds and warned the family not to contact the police.
ex.zh: 绑匪索要两百万英镑赎金，并警告那家人不要报警。

ex.en: Doctors warned that long-term misuse of painkillers can gradually impair kidney function.
ex.zh: 医生警告，长期滥用止痛药会逐渐损害肾功能。

ex.en: Traffic accidents kill more than a million people worldwide every year, according to the latest report.
ex.zh: 最新报告显示，全球每年有一百多万人死于交通事故。

ex.en: At the Saturday market, tomatoes are sold by the kilogram rather than in fixed-size boxes.
ex.zh: 在周六集市上，西红柿按千克出售，而不是按固定大小的盒子出售。

ex.en: The recipe requires half a kilo of flour, which is roughly four heaped cups.
ex.zh: 这个食谱需要半千克面粉，大约四大满杯。

ex.en: The nearest hospital lies more than fifty kilometres from the village, along roads that flood each spring.
ex.zh: 最近的医院距村庄五十多公里，沿途道路每年春天都会被淹。

ex.en: Signs placed at every kilometre helped the runners judge how much of the marathon remained.
ex.zh: 每隔一公里设置的标识帮助跑者判断马拉松还剩多少路程。

senses: n. 家属(集合称),亲戚,家族
adj. 有亲属关系的;性质类似的,同类的

ex.en: In many rural communities, kin still play a central role in raising children and caring for the elderly.
ex.zh: 在许多农村社区，亲属在抚养子女和照顾老人方面仍发挥着核心作用。

senses: a. 体贴的；慈祥的；友好的；宽容的

ex.en: What kind of evidence would convince the public that the new policy actually works?
ex.zh: 什么样的证据才能让公众相信新政策确实有效？

ex.en: Children who attend kindergarten often adapt to primary school more quickly than others.
ex.zh: 上过幼儿园的孩子往往比其他孩子更快适应小学生活。

phrases.m: 溺爱某人反而使其受损

ex.en: Her kindness to strangers earned her widespread respect in the local community.
ex.zh: 她对陌生人的善意为她赢得了当地社区的广泛尊重。

ex.en: The king surrendered much of his power under pressure from an increasingly bold parliament.
ex.zh: 在日益强势的议会压力下，国王交出了自己的许多权力。

ex.en: The ancient kingdom collapsed after years of drought and repeated poor harvests.
ex.zh: 经过多年干旱和反复的歉收，这个古代王国覆灭了。

senses: n. 亲属关系,家属关系
kinship.usage: 词根记忆: kin(亲属)+ship(表关系)→亲属关系；索引p411

ex.en: Anthropologists study kinship to understand how societies organise family ties.
ex.zh: 人类学家研究亲属关系，以理解社会如何组织家庭纽带。

ex.en: He felt a strong kinship with other immigrants who shared his experience.
ex.zh: 他与其他有着相同经历的移民感到意气相投。

ex.en: Kinship networks often determine who inherits property in traditional communities.
ex.zh: 在传统社区，亲属网络往往决定着谁继承财产。

ex.en: She kissed her children goodbye before hurrying to catch the early train.
ex.zh: 她亲吻孩子们道了别，然后赶去乘早班火车。

senses: n. 成套工具；成套用品
n. 成套工具,用具包,工具箱

ex.en: Each rescue team carries a standard kit of medical supplies and tools.
ex.zh: 每支救援队都携带一套标准的医疗用品和工具装备。

ex.en: The flat itself is small, but its kitchen is surprisingly spacious and bright.
ex.zh: 公寓本身很小，但厨房却出人意料地宽敞明亮。

ex.en: On windy spring afternoons, children fly kites over the open field near the river.
ex.zh: 在有风的春日午后，孩子们在河边开阔的场地上放风筝。

ex.en: The satellite maintains a stable orbit several hundred km above the earth's surface.
ex.zh: 这颗卫星在地表以上数百公里的稳定轨道上运行。

ex.en: He injured his knee while jogging and had to abandon his training schedule.
ex.zh: 他慢跑时膝盖受伤，不得不放弃训练计划。

senses: a. 本能地做出的；未经思考做出的

ex.en: Opponents accused the government of a knee-jerk reaction to the crisis, taken before any evidence had been examined.
ex.zh: 反对者指责政府对危机做出未经思考的本能反应，未审查任何证据就采取了行动。

ex.en: The gardener knelt in the wet soil to pull out the weeds one by one.
ex.zh: 园丁跪在湿润的泥土里，一根一根地拔除杂草。

ex.en: A sharp knife is essential for preparing vegetables quickly and safely.
ex.zh: 一把锋利的刀对快速而安全地备菜必不可少。

senses: v. 编织,编结;针织,机织
v. (使)愈合,接合;(使)紧密结合
knit.usage: 过去式/过去分词knitted/knit均可；紧密联系close-knit a.紧密的

ex.en: My grandmother taught me to knit scarves during the long winter holidays.
ex.zh: 漫长的寒假期间，祖母教我织围巾。

senses: n. 门把,(球形)把手,旋钮

ex.en: The door would not open until he gave the rusty knob a sharp twist.
ex.zh: 直到他猛地拧了一下生锈的门把手，门才打开。

ex.en: Please knock on the door before entering the manager's office at any time.
ex.zh: 任何时候进经理办公室前都请先敲门。

senses: a. 使产生连锁反应的

ex.en: Analysts warned that the port strike would have a knock-on effect on food prices across the region.
ex.zh: 分析师警告，港口罢工将对整个地区的食品价格产生连锁影响。

ex.en: She tied a firm knot in the rope before hauling the crate up from the boat.
ex.zh: 她在绳子上打了一个结实的结，然后把板条箱从船上吊起。

ex.en: Few consumers know exactly how their personal data is collected and traded online.
ex.zh: 很少有消费者确切知道他们的个人数据是如何在网上被收集和交易的。

ex.en: The company knowingly sold faulty air bags, ignoring internal warnings from its own engineers.
ex.zh: 这家公司明知有缺陷仍出售安全气囊，无视自家工程师的内部警告。

knowledge.usage: n.知识，学问；知道，了解；索引p411

ex.en: Scientific knowledge advances by questioning results that everyone else accepts.
ex.zh: 科学知识是通过质疑众人接受的结果而进步的。

ex.en: To my knowledge, the deadline for applications has not been extended.
ex.zh: 据我所知，申请截止日期尚未延长。

ex.en: Traditional knowledge about medicinal plants is fading as the older generation passes away.
ex.zh: 随着老一代人相继离世，关于药用植物的传统知识正在消失。

senses: a. 博学的；知识渊博的；有见识的

ex.en: A knowledgeable guide can turn an ordinary museum visit into a truly memorable experience.
ex.zh: 一位知识渊博的导游能把普通的博物馆之行变成真正难忘的经历。

senses: n. 节;(尤指)掌指关节;肘,蹄

ex.en: He rapped his knuckles on the director's door and waited, feeling suddenly nervous.
ex.zh: 他屈指敲了敲主任办公室的门，然后等着，突然感到紧张起来。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Kuwait possesses roughly a tenth of the world's proven oil reserves, making it a key energy exporter.
ex.zh: 科威特拥有全球已探明石油储量的大约十分之一，是重要的能源出口国。

ex.en: The compact car's 1.6 l engine keeps fuel costs low without sacrificing too much power.
ex.zh: 这款紧凑型轿车的1.6升发动机在不牺牲太多动力的情况下降低了燃油成本。

ex.en: The biology students spent the whole afternoon in the lab examining pond water under microscopes.
ex.zh: 生物课学生整个下午都在实验室里用显微镜观察池塘水。

label.usage: tag 的近义词；辨析:label指附在物品上、标有性质/物主/名称/目的地等的标签；tag指标明商品名称、产地和价格的标签，也可系在行李上

ex.en: Advances in technology have allowed mass-market labels such as Zara, H&M, and Uniqlo to react to trends more quickly.
ex.zh: 科技的进步使Zara、H&M和Uniqlo（优衣库）等大众市场品牌能够更快地对趋势作出反应。

ex.en: Read the label carefully before you take the medicine.
ex.zh: 服药前请仔细阅读标签。

ex.en: He was labelled a troublemaker simply because he questioned the rules.
ex.zh: 仅仅因为质疑规则，他就被贴上了捣乱者的标签。

ex.en: The university's new laboratory allows researchers to simulate extreme weather conditions all year round.
ex.zh: 这所大学的新实验室使研究人员能够全年模拟极端天气条件。

labor.usage: 词组还有 labor shortage 劳动力短缺

ex.en: The company is accused of using cheap labor to cut production costs.
ex.zh: 该公司被指控使用廉价劳动力以削减生产成本。

ex.en: Manual labor is becoming less common as machines take over repetitive tasks.
ex.zh: 随着机器接管重复性工作，体力劳动正变得越来越少见。

ex.en: The Labour Party has pledged to invest more in public education.
ex.zh: 英国工党承诺加大对公共教育的投资。

ex.en: Every vaccine must pass repeated laboratory tests before regulators approve it for public use.
ex.zh: 每种疫苗在监管机构批准公开使用前，都必须通过反复的实验室检测。

ex.en: His grandfather worked as a laborer on the railways for more than thirty years.
ex.zh: 他的祖父在铁路上做了三十多年劳工。

senses: n. 劳工,劳方(总称);分娩,阵痛

ex.en: The humiliations of his father's imprisonment and his labor in the blacking factory formed Dicken's greatest wound and became his deepest secret.
ex.zh: 父亲入狱和鞋油工厂做工带来的种种羞耻让狄更斯伤痕累累,成为埋藏最深的秘密。

ex.en: Rising labour costs have pushed many factories to invest heavily in automation.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的劳动力成本促使许多工厂大力投资自动化。

ex.en: His grandfather worked as an unskilled labourer on the docks, saving every spare coin for his children's schooling.
ex.zh: 他的祖父当年在码头做非技术工人，把每一枚闲钱都攒下来供孩子上学。

ex.en: She paused to lace up her worn running shoes before starting her daily loop of the park.
ex.zh: 她停下来系好那双破旧的跑鞋鞋带，然后开始每天绕公园的跑步。

phrases.m: 缺少,缺乏(多用于否定句)

lack.usage: n.缺乏，不足 v.缺乏，不足；需要；索引p411

ex.en: Britain's towns, it is true, are not prevented from applying, but they generally lack the resources to put together a bid to beat their bigger competitors.
ex.zh: 确实英国的小镇并没有被排除在申请资格之外，但是它们普遍缺少资源来与更强大的竞争对手一较高下。

ex.en: The project failed for lack of funding rather than any flaw in the design.
ex.zh: 该项目失败是因为缺乏资金，而非设计本身有缺陷。

ex.en: Some regions simply lack the infrastructure to support large-scale tourism.
ex.zh: 一些地区简直缺乏支撑大规模旅游业的基础设施。

ex.en: Despite their lack of experience, the young team outperformed every rival.
ex.zh: 尽管缺乏经验，这支年轻的队伍还是胜过了所有对手。

ex.en: As a lad, he delivered newspapers before school every morning to support his family.
ex.zh: 少年时代，他每天早上上学前都去送报以补贴家用。

ex.en: Climbing the career ladder often demands painful sacrifices in personal and family time.
ex.zh: 攀爬职业阶梯往往要求在个人和家庭时间上作出痛苦的牺牲。

senses: n. 女士；夫人；淑女；小姐

ex.en: An elderly lady kindly showed me the way to the railway station.
ex.zh: 一位老妇人好心地给我指了去火车站的路。

senses: v. 缓慢移动；发展缓慢；滞后；落后于
lag.usage: 发音类似“拉哥”→为什么哥哥需要你拉着？因为他落后了，你得拉着他跑→落后于。

ex.en: The little boy lagged behind his parents.
ex.zh: 那小男孩落在了父母的后面。

ex.en: Sales in Europe have lagged behind those in Asia for three years.
ex.zh: 三年来欧洲的销售额一直落后于亚洲。

ex.en: There is usually a time lag between policy changes and their effects.
ex.zh: 政策变化与其效果之间通常存在时间滞后。

ex.en: Industrial waste from nearby factories has severely polluted the lake.
ex.zh: 附近工厂的工业废水严重污染了这片湖泊。

lamb.usage: 有只 lame(跛的)lamb(小羊)卧在 lamp(灯)旁；助记:有只lame(跛的)lamb(小羊)卧在lamp(灯)旁

ex.en: The dish is traditionally made with tender lamb and fresh mountain herbs.
ex.zh: 这道菜传统上用鲜嫩的羊肉和新鲜的山地香草制作。

senses: adj. (借口、解释等)无说服力的,站不住脚的;有缺陷的
adj. 跛的；没有说服力的
lame.usage: 派生lameness残废,跛,瘸；la(拉)+me(我)→你需拉我一下，我有点跛足走不快→跛的

ex.en: Stephen made some lame excuse.
ex.zh: 斯蒂芬找了些站不住脚的借口。

senses: n. 残缺，不完全（备）；跛脚

phrases.p: the lameness of many public-health campaigns
phrases.m: 许多公共健康运动的软弱无力

ex.en: The horse was retired because of permanent lameness in its left leg.
ex.zh: 这匹马因左腿永久性跛疾而退役。

ex.en: Critics pointed out the lameness of the committee's excuses for the delay.
ex.zh: 批评者指出，委员会为拖延找的借口站不住脚。

ex.en: The veterinarian examined the dog's lameness and recommended immediate surgery.
ex.zh: 兽医检查了狗的跛腿，建议立即手术。

senses: adj. 塑封的;覆膜的;由薄片叠成的;层压的,粘合的

ex.en: Laminated copies of the evacuation plan are fixed beside every lift in the hotel.
ex.zh: 酒店的每部电梯旁都贴着塑封的疏散预案。

senses: n. 灯,(尤指治疗或美容用的)发热灯,照射灯

ex.en: He adjusted the lamp so that the light fell directly on his book.
ex.zh: 他调整了台灯，让光线直接落在书本上。

ex.en: The nurse used a sterile lancet to prick the patient's finger and collect a tiny blood sample.
ex.zh: 护士用无菌柳叶刀刺破患者手指，采集了一小份血样。

senses: n. 陆地,大地;地域;国土;(同一类型的)地带
n. 田地,耕地;地产,田产

ex.en: The airline's pilots are trained to land safely even in extremely bad weather.
ex.zh: 这家航空公司的飞行员受过训练，即使在极端恶劣天气下也能安全着陆。

ex.en: The pilot performed a textbook landing despite gusting crosswinds that had delayed earlier arrivals.
ex.zh: 尽管阵性侧风曾使早先的航班延误，这位飞行员仍完成了一次教科书式的降落。

ex.en: Our landlady agreed to fix the leaking roof only after we threatened to withhold the rent.
ex.zh: 直到我们威胁拒付房租，女房东才同意修理漏雨的屋顶。

ex.en: The landlord refused to repair the broken heating system before winter arrived.
ex.zh: 房东拒绝在冬天来临前修理损坏的供暖系统。

senses: n. 里程碑,划时代的事

ex.en: The signing of the treaty was a landmark in the country's environmental history.
ex.zh: 该条约的签署是这个国家环境史上的一个里程碑。

senses: n. 风景,景色;风景画;横排格式
v. 对……做景观美化;给……作园林美化
landscape.usage: 联想记忆：land(陆地)+(e)scape(逃跑)→逃到陆地上看风景→风景；索引p411

ex.en: Wind farms have changed the landscape of many coastal regions.
ex.zh: 风力发电场改变了许多沿海地区的地貌景观。

ex.en: The painter is famous for capturing the English landscape in watercolours.
ex.zh: 这位画家以水彩画描绘英格兰风景而闻名。

ex.en: The political landscape has shifted dramatically since the last election.
ex.zh: 自上次选举以来，政治格局发生了巨大变化。

senses: (比赛用的、有标志的)泳道,跑道
lane.usage: n.小路；道，路；车道；跑道； 航道

ex.en: Drivers must stay in the correct lane when approaching a busy junction.
ex.zh: 驾驶员在接近繁忙的交叉路口时必须待在正确的车道上。

ex.en: Body language often reveals more than spoken words.
ex.zh: 肢体语言往往比言语透露更多的信息。

ex.en: Children acquire language most easily before the age of seven.
ex.zh: 儿童在七岁之前学习语言最为容易。

ex.en: English has become the dominant language of international business.
ex.zh: 英语已成为国际商务的主导语言。

ex.en: The study suggests that early exposure to two languages speeds up language acquisition rather than confusing the child.
ex.zh: 这项研究表明，早期接触两种语言会加快语言习得，而不是让孩子感到困惑。

senses: adj. 没精打采的;懒洋洋的

ex.en: The afternoon heat made the negotiators languid, and the talks drifted without any real progress.
ex.zh: 午后的炎热让谈判代表们无精打采，会谈毫无实质进展。

ex.en: Colourful festival lanterns lined the river, drawing crowds from across the city.
ex.zh: 五彩的节日灯笼沿河排列，吸引了全城的人前来观看。

senses: v. 舔食;拍击(多指海水)

phrases.p: in the lap of the gods

ex.en: The young driver completed the final lap several seconds ahead of his closest rival.
ex.zh: 这位年轻车手以数秒的优势领先最接近的对手完成了最后一圈。

senses: n. 小错,记错,疏忽;堕落,失足;(时间的)流逝,过去
v. 陷入或进入某种状态;失效

phrases.p: after a lapse of six months

ex.en: A momentary lapse in concentration allowed the thief to slip the wallet from his jacket pocket.
ex.zh: 一瞬间的注意力疏忽让小偷从他夹克口袋里偷走了钱包。

ex.en: She keeps her laptop fully charged in case an urgent meeting is called.
ex.zh: 她让笔记本电脑保持满电状态，以防突然召开紧急会议。

ex.en: The root larg, meaning 'large or generous', appears in enlarge, largely and largess.
ex.zh: 词根 larg 意为“大、宽宏”，见于 enlarge、largely 和 largess 等词。

ex.en: A large proportion of graduates end up in jobs unrelated to their degrees.
ex.zh: 很大一部分毕业生最终从事的工作与他们的学位无关。

senses: ad. 在很大程度上；多半；主要地
adv. 在很大程度上；多半；主要地
adv. 在很大程度上；主要地

ex.en: However, there is another important part of the jobs picture that was largely overlooked.
ex.zh: 然而，就业形势中的另一个重要部分很大程度上被忽视了。

ex.en: The decline of the species is largely due to the loss of its coastal breeding grounds.
ex.zh: 该物种的减少主要源于其沿海繁殖地的丧失。

ex.en: The reforms were largely symbolic and changed little in daily practice.
ex.zh: 这些改革在很大程度上只是象征性的，对日常实践几乎没有改变。

ex.en: Whether the plan succeeds depends largely on local cooperation.
ex.zh: 该计划能否成功在很大程度上取决于当地的合作。

ex.en: Surgeons used a precise laser beam to repair the damaged retina without cutting the surrounding tissue.
ex.zh: 外科医生用精确的激光束修复受损的视网膜，无需切开周围组织。

senses: n. 鞭子,鞭打;责骂,讽刺;猛冲,急动
n. 鞭子,鞭打;责骂,讽刺;猛冲,急动;睫毛
v. 鞭打,抽打,鞭策;猛击,冲击;摆动;捆绑,勒紧,扎牢

ex.en: The crew lashed the containers to the deck before the storm reached the ship.
ex.zh: 船员们在风暴来袭之前把集装箱牢牢捆在甲板上。

ex.en: The strike lasted three weeks before management finally agreed to negotiate.
ex.zh: 罢工持续了三周，管理层才最终同意谈判。

senses: a. 接近末期的；迟到的；近日暮的

ex.en: All this was put at great risk late last month, when the U.S. Supreme Court issued a ruling in an Idaho case that provides the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) far less authority to regulate wetlands and waterways.
ex.zh: 然而,上月月底,这一切都面临着巨大的风险。当时,美国最高法院在爱达荷州的一个案件中做出裁决,大大削弱了美国环境保护局(EPA)管理湿地和水道的权力。

senses: ad. 最近；新近；近来；不久前
lately.usage: 辨析:口语用lately/of late,正式文体用recently;与现在时连用最好用now/at present等

ex.en: Lately, researchers have paid far more attention to sleep and mental health.
ex.zh: 近来，研究人员对睡眠和心理健康的关注大大增加。

senses: adj. 潜在的,隐伏的,不易察觉的

ex.en: Psychologists believe that creative talent often remains latent until circumstances demand its expression.
ex.zh: 心理学家认为，创造才能往往处于潜伏状态，直到环境需要它表现出来。

senses: a. 后来的；接近末期的

ex.en: Years later, the report proved alarmingly accurate in its economic predictions.
ex.zh: 多年以后，这份报告的经济预测被证明惊人地准确。

senses: adj. 侧面的，旁边的，横向的

ex.en: Career experts often recommend a lateral move within a company as a way to broaden experience.
ex.zh: 职业专家常建议在公司内部平级调动，以此拓宽经验。

senses: n. [U] 拉丁语 [C] 拉丁人
a. 拉丁语的；拉丁人的

ex.en: Many English scientific terms derive directly from Latin roots.
ex.zh: 许多英语科学术语直接源自拉丁语词根。

senses: n. 纬度（地区）；选择的自由

ex.en: These birds only survive in temperate latitudes.
ex.zh: 这些鸟只有在温带才能存活。

senses: a. （两者之中的）后者的；后期的
latter.usage: adj.（两者之中的）后者的;后 期的 n.后者

ex.en: Of the two options, I prefer the latter because it costs less.
ex.zh: 在这两个选项中，我更喜欢后者，因为它成本更低。

ex.en: The latter half of the nineteenth century saw rapid industrialisation.
ex.zh: 十九世纪后半叶见证了快速的工业化。

ex.en: He studied law and then medicine; the latter proved more rewarding.
ex.zh: 他先学法律后学医，结果证明后者更有成就。

ex.en: The audience laughed at the politician's clumsy attempt to dodge the question.
ex.zh: 观众对那位政客笨拙的回避问题的企图报以笑声。

ex.en: Shared laughter in the classroom can lower anxiety and encourage participation.
ex.zh: 课堂上的共同笑声能降低焦虑并鼓励学生参与。

launch.usage: embark 的近义词；initiate 的近义词；v.发动，发起；发射；启动 n.发射；上市；发起；科学家们吃完午饭lunch就准备火箭发射launch啦；串词记忆：发射(launch)完火箭再吃午饭(lunch)。；索引p411

ex.en: Police have launched an investigation into the incident.
ex.zh: 警方已对该事件展开调查。

ex.en: Michelle Obama launched a high-visibility campaign against childhood obesity, even claiming that it represents our greatest national security threat.
ex.zh: 米歇尔·奥巴马发起了一项大规模的抵制儿童肥胖症的活动，甚至声称儿童肥胖是国家安全的最大威胁。

ex.en: A century ago Octavia Hill launched the National Trust not to rescue stylish houses but to save "the beauty of natural places for everyone forever."
ex.zh: 一个世纪以前，奥克塔维亚·希尔创办了国民信托组织，目的不是挽救时髦建筑，而是"为每个人永久地留存自然之地的美"。

ex.en: The hotel offers a free laundry service for guests staying more than a week.
ex.zh: 这家酒店为住店超过一周的客人提供免费洗衣服务。

senses: n. [C] 重要奖项（尤指诺贝尔奖）获得者

ex.en: The newly crowned Nobel laureate credited her success to decades of unfashionable, patient research.
ex.zh: 这位新科诺贝尔奖得主把自己的成功归功于数十年不赶时髦的耐心研究。

ex.en: Passengers are reminded that seat belts must remain fastened except when visiting the lavatory.
ex.zh: 乘客须知：除上洗手间外，安全带必须始终保持系紧。

senses: n. 法律；（针对某项罪行、协议等的一条）法规；定律

ex.en: If the bills become law, state boards and commissions will be required to set aside 50 percent of board seats for women by 2022.
ex.zh: 如果这些法案变成了法律，那么到2022年将要求州政府委员会为女性留出50%的委员会席位。

ex.en: Under the new law, companies must report their carbon emissions every year.
ex.zh: 根据新法律，公司必须每年报告其碳排放情况。

ex.en: Scientists have discovered a law governing how heat spreads through metals.
ex.zh: 科学家发现了一条支配热量如何在金属中传导的定律。

lawful.usage: adj.合法的，法定的 practice(美式practise)/'præktɪs/(词频27)

ex.en: The court must decide whether the search of the premises was conducted in a lawful manner.
ex.zh: 法庭必须裁定对该场所的搜查是否以合法方式进行。

senses: adj. 不守法的；不受法律控制的

ex.en: Contemporary accounts describe the mining town as a lawless place where disputes were settled with fists or guns.
ex.zh: 当时的记载把这个矿业小镇描述为法外之地，争端靠拳头或枪支解决。

ex.en: Lawmakers are debating stricter rules on advertising aimed at children.
ex.zh: 立法者正在就针对儿童的广告的更严格规则展开辩论。

ex.en: During the drought, residents were asked to water their lawns only after sunset.
ex.zh: 干旱期间，居民被要求只在日落后给草坪浇水。

ex.en: Many of them instead become the kind of nuisance-lawsuit filer that makes the tort system a costly nightmare.
ex.zh: 他们（指法律专业毕业生）中的很多人反而成了那种妨害案件的诉讼提起人，这使得侵权诉讼体系成为一场价格昂贵的噩梦。

ex.en: The company faces a lawsuit over the safety of its popular painkiller.
ex.zh: 该公司因其畅销止痛药的安全问题面临诉讼。

ex.en: Consumers filed a lawsuit against the airline for cancelling flights without notice.
ex.zh: 消费者因航空公司未作通知就取消航班而对其提起诉讼。

ex.en: Consult a lawyer before signing any agreement that transfers intellectual property.
ex.zh: 在签署任何转让知识产权的协议之前，先咨询律师。

ex.en: The company's lawyers spent months reviewing every clause of the merger contract.
ex.zh: 该公司的律师花了几个月审查合并合同的每一条款。

ex.en: She gave up a lucrative career as a corporate lawyer to teach public-interest law.
ex.zh: 她放弃了报酬丰厚的公司律师职业，转而教授公益法。

ex.en: The official report lays the blame for the accident on years of poor maintenance.
ex.zh: 官方报告将事故归咎于多年来维护不善。

ex.en: A thick layer of smog covered the city throughout the winter months.
ex.zh: 整个冬季，厚厚的一层烟雾笼罩着这座城市。

senses: n. 平信徒,在俗教徒,俗人
layman.usage: 躺（lay）平的人（man）在正常情况下，怎么也不可能成为某个行业的精英，就是个“外行”

ex.en: The booklet explains the legal process in plain terms that a layman can follow.
ex.zh: 这本小册子以外行能够理解的白话解释法律程序。

senses: n. 临时解雇;操作停止;失业期

ex.en: Workers blamed the sudden layoff of three hundred staff on management's costly expansion overseas.
ex.zh: 工人们将三百名员工的突然裁员归咎于管理层耗资巨大的海外扩张。

senses: n. 版面设计；布局；设计

ex.en: A clear page layout helps readers absorb complex information more quickly.
ex.zh: 清晰的版面设计有助于读者更快地吸收复杂信息。

senses: a. 懒散的；无精打采的；马虎的；行进缓慢的

ex.en: Simply calling students lazy ignores the social pressures they actually face.
ex.zh: 简单地把学生称为懒惰，忽视了他们实际面临的社会压力。

senses: vt.&vi. 带路；领路；引领；通向；通往
vt. 处于领先地位；过（某种生活）；引导；领路
n. 领先地位；榜样 [led] n. 铅
lead.usage: 谐音记忆：发音近似“立德”→品德好的人才能领导他人→领导；索引p411

ex.en: But it has already sparked significant controversy, with the United States trade representative opening an investigation into whether the tax discriminates against American companies, which in turn could lead to trade sanctions against France.
ex.zh: 但它（指数字服务税）引发了巨大的争议，美国贸易代表已开始调查该税是否歧视美国公司，这进而可能导致美国对法国的贸易制裁。

ex.en: She will lead the research team for the next three years.
ex.zh: 未来三年将由她领导这个研究团队。

ex.en: All exits lead to the central hall, so you cannot get lost.
ex.zh: 所有出口都通向中央大厅，所以你不会迷路。

leader.usage: n.领袖，领导者，负责人，指挥 者，领唱者；索引p411

ex.en: Japan was, and remains, the global leader in automotive-assembly productivity.
ex.zh: 日本过去是，现在仍然是汽车装配生产率方面的全球引领者。

ex.en: A good leader listens carefully before making difficult decisions.
ex.zh: 优秀的领导者在做出艰难决定之前会仔细倾听。

ex.en: The party leader promised to cut taxes for low-income families.
ex.zh: 该党领袖承诺为低收入家庭减税。

senses: n. 领导（地位）；领导班子；领导才能
leadership.usage: n.领导，领导的才能或能力，带 路，指引；索引p411

ex.en: Under her leadership, the company doubled its overseas sales within five years.
ex.zh: 在她的领导下，公司在五年内将海外销售额翻了一番。

phrases.p: take a leaf out of sb.'s book

ex.en: Each green leaf of the plant absorbs sunlight to carry out photosynthesis.
ex.zh: 植物的每片绿叶都吸收阳光以进行光合作用。

ex.en: Volunteers pushed a leaflet explaining the new recycling rules through every letterbox on the street.
ex.zh: 志愿者向街上每家每户的信箱里投放了一份解释新回收规定的传单。

ex.en: House prices in the leafy suburbs rose twice as fast as those in the city centre.
ex.zh: 绿树成荫的郊区房价上涨速度是市中心的两倍。

ex.en: The small club rose to the top league within five years.
ex.zh: 这家小俱乐部在五年内升入了顶级联赛。

ex.en: Several nations formed a league to coordinate fishing quotas in the region.
ex.zh: 几个国家结成联盟，以协调该地区的捕鱼配额。

ex.en: Profits this quarter are in a different league from those of a year ago.
ex.zh: 本季度的利润与一年前相比不可同日而语。

leak.usage: [族]leakage n. 泄漏；leak secrets 泄露秘密

ex.en: A Google search can leak between 0.2 and 7.0 grams of CO2, depending on how many attempts are needed to get the "right" answer.
ex.zh: 每用谷歌搜索一次就会释放出0.2至7.0克二氧化碳，释放量的多少取决于用户需要搜索多少次才能获取“正确”答案。

ex.en: Officials traced the gas leak to a corroded pipe beneath the street.
ex.zh: 官员们查明煤气泄漏源于街下一根被腐蚀的管道。

ex.en: Details of the merger leaked to the press hours before the official announcement.
ex.zh: 合并细节在正式宣布前几小时泄露给了媒体。

ex.en: A small leak in the roof had gone unnoticed for months.
ex.zh: 屋顶上一处小渗漏数月未被发现。
